faqs.q: What's the minimum commitment?
faqs.a: One month is the minimum. Below that, our daily / weekly rentals are a better fit.

faqs.q: Can I cancel early?
faqs.a: Yes. Early termination incurs the difference between the tier rate you chose and the next-shorter tier rate, calculated against the days you actually drove.

faqs.q: What happens to maintenance?
faqs.a: Wheels handles all servicing. Drop the car off; we hand you a replacement; you pick it back up.

faqs.q: Can I swap to a different car?
faqs.a: Yes, once per quarter for free on tiers ≥ 3 months. Same category swaps are easy; category upgrades adjust the daily rate.

faqs.q: Is the deposit different for long-term?
faqs.a: Same deposit by category as a day rental. It's released after the final return.

faqs.q: How is monthly billing handled?
faqs.a: First month at start; subsequent months on the same date by card or transfer. A single statement at the end of each calendar month.

faqs.q: Is there a minimum contract?
faqs.a: Starter requires no contract, month-to-month billing. Growth typically runs on a 6-month agreement. Enterprise terms are custom.

faqs.q: How does billing work?
faqs.a: A single monthly invoice consolidated by employee, project, or cost centre. Payment by bank transfer (Lebanese or international) or card. Net-15 by default; Net-30 for Enterprise.

faqs.q: Who can drive our corporate vehicles?
faqs.a: Any of your employees with a valid licence and our standard age requirement (25+). Driver documents stored once in your portal and re-used across bookings.

faqs.q: Can we change vehicle classes mid-contract?
faqs.a: Yes. Growth and Enterprise tiers include free swaps once per quarter; same-category swaps are immediate, class upgrades adjust the daily rate proportionally.

faqs.q: Do you deliver to our office?
faqs.a: Free delivery anywhere in Greater Beirut for Growth and Enterprise. Starter delivery is at standard zone-based rates.

faqs.q: Can our visiting executives use the account?
faqs.a: Yes. International licences in Latin script are accepted; for non-Latin licences, an International Driving Permit is required. We can pre-authorise drivers ahead of arrival.
